policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="m365RequestBody" value="@{
			var raw = context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(raw))
			{
				return new Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject();
			}
			return Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject.Parse(raw);
		}" />
        @{
			var body = (Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject)context.Variables["m365RequestBody"];

			var sessionId =
                context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("x-session-id", "") ?? 
                context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("x-conversation-id", "") ?? 
                context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("x-ms-client-session-id", "") ??
				body.SelectToken("session_id") ??
				body.SelectToken("conversation_id") ??
				body.SelectToken("thread_id") ??
				body.SelectToken("client_tracking_id") ??
				context.RequestId;

			var userQuery =
				body.SelectToken("question") ??
				body.SelectToken("user_query") ??
				body.SelectToken("input") ??
				string.Empty;

			var transformed = new Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject
			{
				["session_id"] = sessionId,
				["user_query"] = userQuery
			};

			return transformed.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
		}
        
            application/json
        
        POST
